examples.text: Hier erfuhr er, dass seine Brüder ihre Hochzeit feiern, und an demselben Tage sollte seine Braut mit dem Könige selbst getraut werden. Das beklomm dem Königssohne das Herz, aber was konnte er thuen?
examples.translation: Here he discovered that his brothers were celebrating their weddings, and on this same day his bride was to be wed to the king himself. This grieved the heart of the king's son, but what could he do? [Context: The bride was supposed to be marrying the king's son, not the king.]
examples.english: Here he discovered that his brothers were celebrating their weddings, and on this same day his bride was to be wed to the king himself. This grieved the heart of the king's son, but what could he do? [Context: The bride was supposed to be marrying the king's son, not the king.]

glosses: to make anxious or uneasy; to tighten with anxiety

examples.text: Man versuchte, die Mauer mit Leitern zu beklimmen.

glosses: beeindrucken, beengen und eine sanfte Unruhe hinterlassen

examples.text: „So fand sie es ganz natürlich, dass ihr das Herz lebhaft schlug, und ihr die Brust beklomm.“
„Das beklomm dem Königssohne das Herz, aber was konnte er thuen?“ (1886)
